name: Genesis Plaza
description: The heart of GitHub Multiverse: Welcome Hall, Theatre, Events Wall, pond and shops

name: Genesis Districts
description: Vegas, Fashion, Aetheria and private lots

name: Horizon & Somnium
description: Social hub with a keynote podium

name: HQ Lobby
description: Social room around the central desk

name: Repository Pavilion
description: Exhibition of green and blue blocks

name: Scrum & Agile
description: Kanban whiteboards and sticky notes

name: Upland Gallery
description: Real estate and an art wall

name: GamiMall
description: Wearables mall

name: House of MAC
description: Aluminum plaza with a live music stage

name: Cyberpunk Repo
description: Neon pillars and server racks

name: Arcade Room
description: Arcade cabinets and a pool table

name: Hacker House
description: Two-story house

name: Sandbox Voxels
description: Voxel castle and quest node

name: Retro Contributions
description: A 3D contribution graph

name: Tropical Beach
description: Palm trees, chairs and umbrellas On the shore of the West Sea, at the edge of Genesis City.

name: Zen Temple
description: Private floating island above the lake

name: Holo Workspace
description: Futuristic glass workspace with laptops and a commit leaderboard

name: Parkour Park
description: Red floating platforms, coins and a timer, Toki Land style

name: Tech Square
description: Times Square-style giant screens with live GitHub commits, Big Tech stocks and dev trends

name: Gamer District
description: Gravity Flip tower, arcades, LAN party and a mini-game arena

name: Aero-Glass Oasis
description: A neighborhood of floating glass villas with smart glass and low-gravity infinity pools

name: Graphic Equalizer
description: The Tower of Icons: real app icons pulse like a giant equalizer; every icon you step on plays its own effect

name: Soundwave Festival
description: A big music event amplifying Spotify: LED gate, main stage, lasers, sound waves and a dancing crowd

name: Multiverse Hotel
description: Architectural hotel: giant neon M facade, red swirl lobby, floating beds. Sleep at night to skip it

name: The Pit Arena
description: Half-sunken fight club stadium: concrete ring, red light line, spotlight truss and stands

name: The Candlestick Maze
description: Holographic glass walls rise and fall with the live price of MANA, ETH and Bitcoin; the floor glows green or red

name: The Terminal Apex
description: The >_ Root: a building shaped like the terminal icon, code rain walls, Commit Pod elevators, Bug Bounty Dungeons and a Jobs Board

name: MetaBlock Estates
description: Hypermodern suburb: demo mansions to test drive, a customization garage, residential scripts and a brokers hub

name: The Orchard Nexus
description: A floating glass cube on beams of light over a circular park: Vision Pro quest, smart home demos and the Genius Bar AI

name: The Azure Cloud Core
description: A giant glowing data cloud floating over Azure Island: upload beam entrance, Data Stream core, voxel sandbox on top and the Cloud Storage Lounge

name: The Mob Maze
description: A blocky voxel dungeon maze: stone brick halls, checkered floors, glowing pressure plates, lanterns and traps

name: The Glass Cube
description: A Fifth Avenue-style glass cube on a granite plaza. A spiral staircase goes down to the Underground Tech Hub, where commits give +5 MVC

name: The Hotel
description: A two-floor log chalet alone in a clearing of a dense pine forest, with a backyard bunker and the ventilation-duct maze

name: Museum of Forgotten Tech
description: Walk inside a floppy, climb a giant CPU, parkour a CRT

name: Debug Dungeon
description: Co-op dungeon crawler: squash famous bugs

name: Open Source HQ
description: Code murals, floating rooms and visual Pull Requests

name: Keynote Amphitheater
description: Live tech keynotes and dev wearables

name: Green-Tech Sandbox
description: Solar, wind and greener code: plant trees with /plant

name: Silicon Valley
description: One campus with the HQs of Apple, Google, Meta, Anthropic, OpenAI, GitHub, NVIDIA, Tesla, EA and more

name: Crypto Valley
description: Next to Silicon Valley: a crypto-futurist district of HQs, NFT art galleries and financial towers with live market LED screens, floating buildings and a central networking plaza

name: .jpeg World
description: A world built from real photographs: photo-textured blocks, plain white signs. Enter through the world border at the north edge of Genesis City
